entry.title: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training
entry.summary: We scale the Muon optimizer to large language model training. With weight decay and a per-parameter update scale, Muon trains a 16B mixture-of-experts LLM with about half the compute of AdamW, which makes LLM training markedly more efficient.

entry.title: The Era of 1-bit LLMs: BitNet b1.58 and ternary weights
entry.summary: BitNet b1.58 trains every LLM weight as a ternary value in {-1, 0, 1}. The ternary weights match full-precision LLM training quality while making inference far more efficient in memory, latency and energy.

entry.title: Parallax attention for unsupervised stereo correspondence learning
entry.summary: A parallax attention mechanism captures stereo correspondence along epipolar lines. Parallax attention is trained without ground-truth disparity and handles large disparity variations.

entry.title: Measurement of the positive muon anomalous magnetic moment to 0.46 ppm
entry.summary: We report a measurement of the anomalous precession frequency of the positive muon in a storage ring. The muon spin precession was recorded with an efficient calorimeter system and its training data set of calibration pulses.

entry.title: Gaia Data Release 2: stellar parallax and proper motions
entry.summary: Gaia DR2 provides the parallax of 1.3 billion sources. We describe the astrometric solution and the validation of each parallax against quasars, an efficient reference frame for the whole catalogue.
